title: Founding Footing in Barcelona
style: Adult contemporary bossa nova with a relaxed Brazilian sway and polished 2020s production. Nylon-string guitar and understated syncopated percussion establish the groove; warm electric piano, rounded bass, and restrained brushed drums fill out the verses. Intimate female lead with a natural British accent, clear diction, and a measured, reflective delivery; lift into a memorable, graceful chorus with soft harmony layers. Keep the arrangement elegant and spacious, adding subtle strings in the final chorus and resolving with a gentle guitar-led outro.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The office emptied out, the calendar went still
I saw the shape of every day against the window sill
I’d built a steady name, kept every promise made
But when the old routine came back, I felt my mind had changed

[Pre-Chorus]
So I drew one careful line
And waited for the right design

[Chorus]
I found my footing in Barcelona
A different table, a wider view
From Eixample mornings to London evenings
I kept the work, but changed the room
Across the water, through every border
I learned what mattered, what I could choose
Barcelona, I made a home here
And found a life that felt like mine anew

[Verse 2]
February, twenty-one, a freelance start in hand
Burn Capital, European work, a map I’d understand
Then Casa del Tresor, where all the routes aligned
Debt and bonds and careful trust, with Thomas’s plans in mind

[Pre-Chorus]
Banks and borders, names and needs
Years of friendship under all the deeds

[Chorus]
I found my footing in Barcelona
A different table, a wider view
From Eixample mornings to London evenings
I kept the work, but changed the room
Across the water, through every border
I learned what mattered, what I could choose
Barcelona, I made a home here
And found a life that felt like mine anew

[Bridge]
São Paulo still calls from the other side
Birmingham keeps its place in my heart
Three cities, three ways to belong
And room for a new beginning to start

[Final Chorus]
I found my footing in Barcelona
A steady purpose, a wider view
From Eixample mornings to London evenings
I kept my skill and changed the room
Across the water, through every border
I built a life I could choose
Barcelona, I made a home here
And found a life that felt like mine anew

[Outro]
The city turns at an easy pace
And I have found my place
